summary: Elite Health Systems Inc. filed an 8-K announcing that its board authorized management to review strategic alternatives, including equity/debt capital, asset sales, mergers, or a disposition of all assets. No specific terms, price, premium, or timetable were disclosed, and no advisor was named. The company operates through subsidiaries Elite Health Plan and Physician Support Systems and faces competitive/regulatory pressures. There is no assurance a transaction will occur, and failure could materially affect liquidity and going concern. The review is exploratory; watch for further announcements of concrete proposals or a going-concern warning.
